title: Stable Diffusion 2.1 image inpaint

requirements.name: 512-inpainting-ema.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the pinned 5,214,662,094-byte Stable Diffusion 2.1 inpainting checkpoint under ComfyUI/models/checkpoints and verify its SHA-256 before use.

evidence: The checkpoint size/hash and required local core-node inventory were verified on 2026-10-17. The graph has not completed a qualified local or offline run, so execution remains unavailable.

2026-10-29 local 4090 run through the app: 15 s, but the masked area is a smeared brown haze and ignores the prompt. Hidden from the menus; Flux 2 Klein preserve-edit with a SAM mask is the working mask edit.
